title: Marker-Directed State Tape Rewind
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input string, $b$ a four-tape interpreter configuration on $x$, $q,q'$ control states, $T$ a table with cursor $p$, and $\sigma$ a state tape such that $\sigma(0)=0$ and $\sigma(j)\ne0$ for every positive natural number $j$. Suppose that at control state $q$, whenever the state-tape read is $0$, every transition on any input and other work-tape reads is the administrative action that enters $q'$ and moves the state cursor right; whenever that read is not $0$, every such transition is the administrative action that remains in $q$ and moves the state cursor left. Then for every natural number $j$, starting in control state $q$ with tape $\sigma$ and state cursor $j$, after $j+1$ interpreter steps the control is $q'$, the state cursor is $1$, and the table, tape, and all other configuration data are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Base configuration $b$ of the four-tape interpreter on $x$
Transition condition for all input and work reads when the state-tape read is $0$
Transition condition for all input and work reads when the state-tape read is not $0$
replaced:
Let $\sigma$ be a state tape whose cell $0$ reads the marker bit $0$ and none
of whose cells at positive natural positions reads $0$ (they may be $1$ or
blank).  Let $q$ be an interpreter control state such that, for every
combination of reads whose state-tape read is $0$, the transition at $q$ is
the administrative action passing to a fixed state $q'$ and moving the state
cursor right, and for every combination whose state-tape read is not $0$ it
is the administrative action staying in $q$ and moving the state cursor left,
in both cases touching nothing else.  Then for every natural number $j$,
starting from the evaluation configuration in state $q$ with state tape
$\sigma$ and state cursor $j$, exactly $j + 1$ interpreter steps reach state
$q'$ with state cursor $1$, leaving $\sigma$, the table cursor, and all other
data unchanged.  The hypotheses are deliberately independent of whether the
traversed cells are erased blanks or retained unary symbols.
